analysis_steps.goal: Reduce SCUBA-2 maps and detect sources

method.value: smurf dimm map-making, match filter, top-down peak finding at SNR>=3

evidence.quote: The faint point-source recipe in the orac-dr pipeline was used for the reduction.
the false detection rate for sources at a $>$ 3.5 $\sigma$ significance limit was $\sim$ 8 per cent

analysis_steps.goal: Identify counterparts using ALMA, radio, MIPS and IRAC colours

method.value: Corrected-Poisson probabilities with IRAC colour cuts; ALMA used as guide

evidence.quote: the corrected-Poisson probabilistic analysis from (cite: Downes86) was employed (see also (cite: Dunlop89)).
50 of the 69 unique SCUBA-2 sources brighter than $S_{\rm 850\mu m}$ $=$ 3.5 mJy had an ALMA-detected counterpart

analysis_steps.goal: Derive SFRs and stellar masses and fit cluster evolution

method.value: 850um-SFR scaling relation, summed within 1 Mpc, normalised by M200, fit (1+z)^gamma

evidence.quote: A fit to the evolution in $\Sigma_{\rm SFR}/M_{\rm cl}$ of the form $\Sigma_{\rm SFR}/M_{\rm cl}  \propto (1+z)^\gamma$ gave a median trend
from the 2018A EAO starlink release
Extensive use was made of topcat (cite: Taylor05) in this study.
